external_identity.name: Battery Data Set
external_identity.official_citation: B. Saha and K. Goebel (2007). Battery Data Set, NASA Prognostics Data Repository, NASA Ames Research Center, Moffett Field, CA

untouched_audit_before_freeze.claim_scope: outcome-untouched one-shot external dataset identity selected from public metadata; not a prospective laboratory trial

information_isolation.stage_1: cycle type/time plus charge-record measurements only; write and hash all predictions before any discharge outcome access
information_isolation.stage_2: read only frozen discharge locators and discharge Capacity; no model or prediction changes

structural_roster.file_rule: all MATLAB files in the official archive and recursively expanded nested archives, without outcome-based file selection
structural_roster.cycle_pairing: each charge record is paired with the first subsequent discharge before the next charge; impedance records may intervene
structural_roster.prediction_records: structurally valid paired records after the first five structurally valid paired records

feature_contract.current_convention: absolute value of Current_measured on charge records
feature_contract.charge_throughput: trapezoidal integral of charge-current magnitude in Ah
feature_contract.temperature_missingness: permitted and handled by the already-frozen source imputer

label_contract.reference_capacity: median of the first five structurally valid paired discharge capacities per physical cell
label_contract.target: Capacity divided by the initial-five median capacity
label_contract.invalid_anchor_rule: exclude the complete cell from confirmatory scoring and report the label-contract failure; never substitute later capacities
label_contract.invalid_post_anchor_rule: exclude the individual record from scoring and report it; do not change predictions

statistics.within_cell_metric: mean absolute error across all scorable post-anchor records
statistics.primary_estimand: cell-equal mean of paired within-cell MAE difference, final prefix-causal method minus its causal protected baseline

decision_gates.execution: at least four confirmatory physical cells
retain_if_all: cell-equal mean method-minus-baseline MAE is below zero
at least 75% of confirmatory cells have lower method MAE than baseline MAE
maximum paired cell-macro MAE harm is at most 0.01
maximum per-record displacement and observed absolute-loss regret are at most 0.01, and every protected and final trajectory is non-increasing
decision_gates.inconclusive: execution gate fails or the frozen data contract cannot be adjudicated without outcome inspection
decision_gates.reject: execution gate passes but any retain gate fails
